title.en: Resistively loaded NMOS differential pair with a current-source tail
title.zh: 电阻负载 NMOS 差分对，电流源尾

description.en: An NMOS differential pair with resistor loads and a current-source tail, driven by two antiphase sources. Schematic generated by the RNL solver.
description.zh: 电阻负载的 NMOS 差分对，电流源作尾，由两路反相信号源驱动。原理图由 RNL 求解器生成。
